Find out how plasma conditions at space affect wireless energy transmission.
Description

Find out how plasma conditions at space affect wireless energy transmission under a modular satellite schema. Geiger counter to measure space radiation, a graphene transistor, a wireless power transfer system, MEMS (microelectromechanical systems) , experimental solar panels, a Peltier cell and a camera.
